name: CCNA and Enterprise Networking
certifications: Cisco CCNP Enterprise (350-401 ENCOR and a concentration exam)

beginner.summary: For new network engineers, support staff and students. Covers network models, Ethernet and switching, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, the Cisco IOS command line, VLANs, trunking and inter-VLAN routing, spanning tree, EtherChannel, static routes, OSPF, IPv6, DHCP and DNS, NAT, access lists, wireless LANs, device security and network services, all practised in Packet Tracer and CML labs.
prerequisites: Comfortable using computers and a command prompt
Basic arithmetic for binary and subnetting
outcomes: Explain how data moves through networks using the OSI and TCP/IP models
Address and subnet IPv4 and IPv6 networks
Configure Cisco switches and routers for VLANs, routing, NAT and ACLs

subtopics: What a network is: LAN, WAN and the internet
Network devices: switches, routers, firewalls and access points
Network types: campus, data centre, branch and cloud
Cisco certifications and the CCNA exam
Introducing Cisco Modeling Labs and GNS3
days.lab_task: Install Packet Tracer and Wireshark, build a small network with two PCs, a switch and a router, ping between the PCs and capture the ping in simulation mode and Wireshark.
days.deliverable: Lab file, screenshots and a capture with notes
checks: View the ping in simulation mode
Switch, router and end device roles correct

days.topic: OSI and TCP/IP Models and Encapsulation
subtopics: Protocol data units: frames, packets and segments
days.lab_task: Capture a web page download in Wireshark, label the Ethernet, IP and TCP headers, find the three-way handshake and match five fault examples to OSI layers.
days.deliverable: Annotated capture and fault mapping
checks: Source and destination at layers 2, 3 and 4 correct

days.topic: Ethernet, Cabling and How Switches Forward Frames
days.lab_task: Watch a switch build its MAC address table, clear it and watch it relearn, cause a duplex mismatch and find it from interface counters, and trace ARP requests and replies.
days.deliverable: MAC table output, interface counters and notes
checks: Each PC's MAC on the right port
Errors seen in counters and fixed

subtopics: Special addresses: loopback, APIPA and broadcast
Configuring addresses on hosts and routers
days.lab_task: Address a three-network lab by hand, configure hosts and router interfaces, convert ten addresses between binary and decimal and fix a host with the wrong gateway.
days.deliverable: Addressing table, configuration and conversions
checks: Host reaches other networks after the fix

days.lab_task: Design a VLSM plan for a site with five departments of different sizes from one /24, apply it in the lab and complete 20 timed subnetting questions.
days.deliverable: VLSM plan, lab configuration and timed results
checks: No overlaps and every department fits

days.topic: Cisco IOS Command Line and Device Configuration
days.lab_task: Configure a switch and router from factory settings with hostnames, passwords, banners and interfaces, save the configuration, back it up to TFTP and restore it after an erase.
days.deliverable: Configuration files and restore evidence
checks: Device returns to the saved configuration
Interface status and IP summary displayed

subtopics: VLAN design for a small site
days.lab_task: Create VLANs for staff, guests and voice, assign ports, put a phone and PC on one port with a voice VLAN and confirm guests cannot reach staff hosts.
days.deliverable: VLAN configuration and test results
checks: Data and voice VLANs on one port

subtopics: DTP and why to turn it off
days.lab_task: Trunk two switches, route between VLANs with router on a stick, then move routing to a layer 3 switch with SVIs, and fix a native VLAN mismatch.
days.deliverable: Configurations and test results for both designs
checks: Ping between VLANs through the router
Replies received with the router removed

days.lab_task: Build a looped three-switch topology, predict and confirm the root bridge and blocked ports, move the root, enable PortFast with BPDU Guard and catch a rogue switch.
days.deliverable: Predictions, show output and configuration

days.lab_task: Bundle two links between switches with LACP, check load balancing, cause a mismatch that keeps a link out of the bundle and fix it.
days.deliverable: Configuration and show output

days.lab_task: Connect three routers with static routes, add a default route to the internet, add a floating static backup route and fail the main link to watch it take over.
days.deliverable: Routing tables and failover output

days.lab_task: Replace static routes with single-area OSPF, set router IDs, influence path choice with cost, make LAN interfaces passive and fix an adjacency stuck because of a timer mismatch.
days.deliverable: OSPF configuration and show output

subtopics: Address types: global, link-local and unique local
days.lab_task: Add IPv6 to the lab with global and link-local addresses, let hosts autoconfigure with SLAAC, route with static IPv6 routes and OSPFv3 and ping end to end.
days.deliverable: IPv6 configuration and test results

subtopics: DHCP and DNS in the CCNA exam
days.lab_task: Configure DHCP pools on a router for two VLANs, relay requests from a remote VLAN, set DNS and fix a client getting an APIPA address.
days.deliverable: DHCP configuration and test results

days.lab_task: Give internal users internet access with PAT, publish a web server with static NAT, check translations and fix a NAT failure caused by a wrong inside interface.
days.deliverable: NAT configuration and translation output
checks: Reach the web server from outside

days.lab_task: Write ACLs that allow staff to reach the web server only on HTTPS, block guests from internal networks and limit SSH to the admin subnet, and test every rule.
days.deliverable: ACL configuration and test results

days.lab_task: Configure a wireless controller with staff and guest SSIDs mapped to VLANs, WPA3 for staff and an open guest network with isolation, and connect clients to each.
days.deliverable: Controller configuration and client tests

subtopics: Security best practices for small networks
days.lab_task: Replace Telnet with SSH, create local users with privilege levels, enable port security to allow two MAC addresses per port and shut unused ports.
days.deliverable: Security configuration and tests

days.topic: Network Services: NTP, Syslog, SNMP and CDP/LLDP
days.lab_task: Sync all devices with NTP, send logs to a syslog server, poll interfaces with SNMPv3 and draw the network from CDP and LLDP neighbours.
days.deliverable: Service configuration, logs and network map
checks: Event logged on the syslog server
Map matches CDP and LLDP output

days.lab_task: Design and build a network for a 60-person office: VLANs, trunking, inter-VLAN routing, OSPF to a branch, DHCP, NAT, ACLs, wireless, SSH and NTP, then hand it over with documentation and fix a fault planted by the trainer.
days.deliverable: Lab file, addressing plan, configurations and network documentation
checks: All requirements pass the test list
Fault found and fixed with notes
A classmate can find any device and address
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one network

intermediate.summary: For network engineers with CCNA-level knowledge. Covers multi-area OSPF, EIGRP, BGP for the enterprise edge, HSRP, QoS, VPNs, wireless controllers, Layer 2 security, AAA, monitoring with SNMP and NetFlow, troubleshooting method, Python with Netmiko, NETCONF and RESTCONF, Ansible for networks, Catalyst Center, SD-WAN, cloud networking, IPv6 transition, CCNA exam preparation and a campus capstone.
prerequisites: Configures VLANs, trunks, OSPF, NAT and ACLs on Cisco devices
Has worked on or studied for CCNA
outcomes: Design and run enterprise routing with OSPF, EIGRP and BGP
Add redundancy, QoS, VPNs and security to campus and branch networks
Automate configuration with Python, APIs and Ansible
Pass the CCNA and work toward CCNP Enterprise

days.lab_task: Split the network into three OSPF areas, summarise at the ABRs, make a branch area totally stubby and confirm smaller routing tables and correct reachability.
days.deliverable: OSPF design, configuration and table sizes before and after
checks: Expected LSA types in each area

days.lab_task: Run EIGRP in a branch network, find feasible successors, fail the main path to watch instant failover and balance traffic across unequal links with variance.
days.deliverable: EIGRP configuration and failover results
checks: Failover with almost no lost pings

days.lab_task: Connect a company to two internet providers with eBGP, advertise its prefix, prefer one provider outbound with local preference and inbound with AS path prepending, and test failover.
days.deliverable: BGP configuration and test results
checks: Traffic leaves through the preferred provider

days.topic: First Hop Redundancy with HSRP and VRRP
days.lab_task: Give each VLAN a redundant gateway with HSRP, split active roles between two switches, track the uplink and fail it to confirm hosts keep working.
days.deliverable: HSRP configuration and failover results
checks: Active and standby per VLAN as planned

days.lab_task: Mark voice, video and bulk traffic at the access layer, give voice priority on a congested WAN link, shape the WAN to the provider rate and measure voice latency before and after.
days.deliverable: QoS policy and measurements

days.topic: Site-to-Site VPNs with IPsec and GRE
subtopics: Crypto maps and virtual tunnel interfaces
days.lab_task: Build an IKEv2 IPsec tunnel with virtual tunnel interfaces between head office and a branch, run OSPF over it and fix a tunnel failing because of mismatched proposals.
days.deliverable: VPN configuration and test results

days.topic: Wireless LAN Controllers and Enterprise Wireless
days.lab_task: Join access points to a virtual 9800 controller, create an 802.1X staff WLAN and a guest portal, test roaming between APs and troubleshoot a client that cannot authenticate.
days.deliverable: Controller configuration and test results

days.topic: Layer 2 Security: DHCP Snooping, ARP Inspection and 802.1X
days.lab_task: Stop a rogue DHCP server and an ARP spoofing attack with snooping and inspection, require 802.1X on access ports with MAB for printers and limit broadcast storms.
days.deliverable: Security configuration and attack test results
checks: show ip dhcp snooping statistics output

tools: Cisco ISE or FreeRADIUS and tac_plus
days.lab_task: Move device logins to TACACS+ with command authorisation for two roles, keep a local fallback account and review accounting logs for changes.
days.deliverable: AAA configuration, role definitions and logs
checks: Run a restricted command as a junior
Each command logged with the user

days.topic: Network Monitoring with SNMP, Syslog and NetFlow
subtopics: Monitoring tools: LibreNMS, PRTG and others
days.lab_task: Monitor all devices with LibreNMS over SNMPv3, export NetFlow to a collector to find top talkers, and alert on interface errors and high link use.
days.deliverable: Monitoring setup, NetFlow report and alerts
checks: Raise link use above the threshold

subtopics: Troubleshooting methods: top-down, bottom-up and divide and conquer
Packet capture with SPAN and EPC
days.lab_task: Find and fix eight planted faults across switching, routing, NAT, ACLs and services in timed rounds, recording the method used and evidence for each.
days.deliverable: Troubleshooting log for every fault
checks: Every fault fixed within the time limit
Capture used to prove one fault
Method and evidence recorded for each fault

days.topic: Network Automation with Python and Netmiko
subtopics: Parsing output with TextFSM and Genie
days.lab_task: Write a script that collects interface status from every device, parses it into a table, pushes a standard NTP and syslog configuration and reports devices that failed.
days.deliverable: Scripts, inventory and output reports
checks: Change applied on every reachable device

days.topic: Model-Driven Programmability: NETCONF, RESTCONF and YANG
subtopics: Why APIs instead of the CLI
days.lab_task: Read and change interface configuration through NETCONF and RESTCONF, explore the YANG model in YANG Suite and compare the effort with CLI scripting.
days.deliverable: Scripts, Postman collection and comparison note

days.lab_task: Back up all configurations with Ansible, generate VLAN and interface configuration from a template and data file, run in check mode with diff, then apply and re-run with no changes.
days.deliverable: Playbooks, templates, backups and run output
checks: Device returns to the saved state

days.lab_task: Use the Catalyst Center sandbox to view inventory and health, provision a template, read assurance issues and pull device data through its API.
days.deliverable: Screenshots, template and API script

days.lab_task: Use the SD-WAN sandbox to view the overlay, create an application-aware policy that sends video over the best link and check path changes when a link degrades.
days.deliverable: Policy, screenshots and notes
checks: Video moves to the better path

subtopics: Cloud network building blocks: VPCs and VNets
days.lab_task: Build a VPC with public and private subnets, connect it to the lab with a site-to-site VPN from a Cisco router, run BGP over the tunnel and control traffic with security groups.
days.deliverable: Cloud network configuration, router configuration and test results
checks: Ping a private cloud host from the lab
Cloud prefixes learned on the router
Block a port with a security group

days.lab_task: Turn the campus into dual stack with an IPv6 addressing plan, add RA guard, provide NAT64 for an IPv6-only segment and write a rollout plan.
days.deliverable: Addressing plan, configuration and rollout plan
checks: Reach an IPv4 server from an IPv6-only host

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam, review wrong answers, rebuild the weak topics in Packet Tracer and take a second practice exam with simulations.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list
checks: Each weak topic practised in a lab

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Redundant Campus and Branch Network
days.lab_task: Design and build a campus with redundant core, HSRP, multi-area OSPF, dual-homed BGP internet, IPsec branches, QoS, Layer 2 security and AAA, deployed with Ansible, then run failure tests and present.
days.deliverable: Design document, Ansible repository, test results and presentation
checks: Fail a core switch and an internet link
Device back to the standard configuration
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one network

advanced.summary: For senior network engineers and architects. Covers enterprise network design, advanced BGP, route policy and redistribution, MPLS L3VPN, SD-Access, SD-WAN deployment, VXLAN EVPN data centre fabrics, segmentation and zero trust, advanced QoS, multicast, wireless design, hybrid cloud networking, NetDevOps pipelines, streaming telemetry, source of truth, convergence tuning, complex troubleshooting, ENCOR preparation and a network design capstone.
prerequisites: Runs enterprise networks with OSPF, BGP and VPNs
Holds CCNA or has equivalent experience
outcomes: Design scalable, secure enterprise and data centre networks
Deploy fabrics, SD-WAN and hybrid cloud connectivity
Run networks as code with pipelines, telemetry and a source of truth
Solve complex faults and prepare for CCNP Enterprise

subtopics: Hierarchical design: access, distribution and core
days.lab_task: Design the network for a company with a headquarters, a data centre and 40 branches, write high-level and low-level design documents and defend them in a review.
days.deliverable: High-level design, low-level design and review notes
checks: Each requirement met by a design choice
Single failures do not take down more than one site

days.topic: Advanced BGP: Route Reflectors, Communities and Policy
subtopics: BGP security: RPKI and prefix filtering
days.lab_task: Scale iBGP with route reflectors, tag routes with communities to control export, filter bogons and validate origins with RPKI, and steer traffic across three providers.
days.deliverable: BGP design, policies and validation results
checks: Clients learn routes through the reflector

subtopics: Redistribution between OSPF, EIGRP and BGP
days.lab_task: Redistribute between EIGRP and OSPF at two points, reproduce a routing loop, stop it with route tags, then migrate a site from EIGRP to OSPF without an outage.
days.deliverable: Configuration, loop evidence and migration plan
checks: No loss of connectivity during migration

days.lab_task: Build a provider core with MPLS and LDP, connect two customers with overlapping addresses through L3VPNs and share one service between customers with route targets.
days.deliverable: Provider configuration and customer tests
checks: Both customers reach the shared service only

subtopics: Virtual networks and scalable group tags
Fabric roles: border, control and edge
days.lab_task: Design an SD-Access fabric for a campus, define virtual networks and group-based policy, and explain packet flow between two users in different groups.
days.deliverable: Fabric design, policy matrix and packet flow explanation
checks: Allowed and denied group pairs defined
LISP lookup and VXLAN encapsulation described

days.lab_task: Deploy SD-WAN to three lab branches with two transports, segment guest and corporate traffic, add a cloud on-ramp and migrate a branch with no outage.
days.deliverable: SD-WAN design, policies and migration log

days.topic: Data Centre Fabrics with VXLAN EVPN
days.lab_task: Build a spine-leaf fabric with BGP EVPN and VXLAN, stretch a layer 2 segment, route between tenants with anycast gateways and dual-home a server.
days.deliverable: Fabric configuration and test results
checks: Traffic continues on the other leaf

days.topic: Network Segmentation and Zero Trust Architecture
subtopics: Segmentation levels: VRFs, VLANs and groups
days.lab_task: Redesign a flat network into segments for users, servers, OT and guests with firewalls and identity-based policy, and test that lateral movement is blocked.
days.deliverable: Segmentation design, policies and test results
checks: Move laterally from a user to OT

subtopics: QoS for collaboration and real-time apps
days.lab_task: Design end-to-end QoS for voice, video and critical apps across campus, WAN and SD-WAN, apply hierarchical QoS on the WAN edge and validate under congestion.
days.deliverable: QoS design, configuration and validation results
checks: Markings kept or remarked as designed
Parent shaper and child queues working

subtopics: Use cases: video, trading and updates
days.lab_task: Stream video over multicast across three routers with PIM sparse mode, configure a rendezvous point, switch to SSM and troubleshoot a receiver that gets no stream.
days.deliverable: Multicast configuration and troubleshooting notes

days.lab_task: Plan wireless for a three-floor office with a high-density auditorium using a survey tool, choose channels and power, design roaming and security and validate the plan.
days.deliverable: Wireless design, heat maps and validation report
checks: Signal meets the target across the floors

days.lab_task: Connect on-premises to AWS and Azure through a hub design with BGP, centralise inspection for traffic between clouds, resolve DNS across environments and estimate monthly network cost.
days.deliverable: Hybrid design, Terraform code, test results and cost estimate
checks: Data transfer and gateway costs calculated

subtopics: Lab validation with CML or containerlab
Pipelines with GitLab CI or GitHub Actions
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline where a network change is proposed in Git, checked with Batfish, tested in containerlab, approved and deployed with Ansible, with automatic rollback on failed checks.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, tests and change records
checks: Propose a change that breaks reachability

days.lab_task: Stream interface and CPU telemetry from devices with gNMI into InfluxDB, build Grafana dashboards, add synthetic tests for key paths and alert on packet loss.
days.deliverable: Telemetry configuration, dashboards and alerts

days.topic: Source of Truth and Intent with NetBox
days.lab_task: Load the lab network into NetBox, generate device configurations from NetBox data with Ansible, detect a manual change as drift and fix it from the source of truth.
days.deliverable: NetBox data, generated configurations and drift report
checks: Generated configs match the running configs
Device back in line with the source of truth

days.lab_task: Measure baseline failover times, add BFD and tune OSPF and BGP timers, enable fast reroute features and show sub-second convergence for core failures.
days.deliverable: Baseline and tuned timings and configuration

days.topic: Network Capacity Planning and Lifecycle Management
subtopics: Measuring link and device use over time
Software upgrade strategy and golden images
days.lab_task: Forecast link and device use for 18 months from telemetry, list devices reaching end of life, plan software upgrades with golden images and build a three-year refresh budget.
days.deliverable: Capacity forecast, lifecycle report, upgrade plan and budget
checks: Links needing upgrade named with dates
Devices and support end dates listed
Refresh costs by year with priorities

days.lab_task: Diagnose five hard faults (intermittent MTU drops, asymmetric routing through a firewall, a BGP flap, high control plane CPU and a QoS misclassification), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review
checks: Path MTU issue proven with a capture

days.lab_task: Take a timed ENCOR practice exam, review wrong answers by domain, lab the weak topics and take a second practice exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Network Design and Delivery
days.lab_task: Design and deliver a network for a case enterprise: segmented campus, SD-WAN branches, a VXLAN EVPN data centre, hybrid cloud links, NetBox source of truth, a NetDevOps pipeline and telemetry, then run a failure game day and defend the design to a review board.
days.deliverable: Design documents, automation repository, game day report and review presentation
checks: Failures handled within the convergence targets
Tested and deployed without manual steps
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one network
